_comment: THE INCLUDE LIST, and the source of truth for what this page loads.
The page fetches exactly this -- no candidate list, no directory scan -- so
adding a provider to the browser runtime is an edit here and nothing else.
WindowProvider first: it is the one this page exists for, and load order is
ShellProvider second so the navigator still comes up in the embedded
terminal -- drop it and the canvas still works, with nothing to type at.
_scripts: Staged into the browser's MEMFS by the page, by these names, before main()
runs -- so each name here must answer over HTTP. boot.etcs is in www/; the
two pump scripts are MOUNTED at these names from their real location one
level up (../serve_web.etcs), so nothing is duplicated to be servable and no
directory above the tree is exposed.
_glue: The emscripten loader output. em++ -o etcs emits TWO files: 'etcs', which is
JavaScript, and 'etcs.wasm'. Naming it here rather than probing removes a
guaranteed console error -- the page used to try 'etcs.js', fail, and fall
back to 'etcs', so every single load logged a failed script fetch.
STAGE IT AS .js. Served extensionless it arrives as application/octet-stream
and the browser complains that it is not a valid JavaScript MIME type; it
runs anyway today, and that is a warning worth not having. The server is not
the place to fix it -- an extensionless file is not evidence of JavaScript
(FileHtmlPage::MimeForExtension is right to refuse to guess) -- the deploy is,
because the deploy is what knows the file came out of em++.
